themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many reviewers warn of long waits, sometimes up to two hours, though some say it was worth it and a few were seated quickly.
quotes: Come at a silly time or else be prepared to wait... and wait... and wait...
Wait was almost 90 minutes on a Friday night.

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most praise the broth, noodle texture and flavor, some calling it the city's best, while others find it overrated, too salty or with hard noodles.
quotes: The broth is super rich and the noodles with just the right amount of chew and bounce.
The noodles too hard and soups only taste salty very salty.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as fun, lively and inviting, with a pleasant mood and decor, though one found the music too loud.
quotes: I love the atmosphere, which is always inviting.
delicious food, fun vibe and very reasonably priced for the quality and experience

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, attentive and quick service, but a few found staff unfriendly, rushed or declining over time.
quotes: The staff is attentive, but not crowding.
Unfortunately, service has been on a downwards trend and it no longer feels as welcoming or service minded

themes.label: Pork buns and sides
themes.text: Pork buns and other small plates are repeatedly praised as delicious.
quotes: The pork steamed buns were the best I've ever had.

themes.label: Live music and venue
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the live music, bands and DJs, especially in the downstairs space, as a main reason to visit.
quotes: The perfect venue to discover young talents and new bands.
Good live jazz music in the evening and party with dj music at night.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, with shakshuka, falafel and sabich praised, but one reviewer found it bland and not fresh.
quotes: The best sabich I've had in New York.
Hummus may have been from a package. Salad was not fresh. Falafel had no flavor.

themes.label: Prices and drink deals
themes.text: Reviewers describe drinks and food as affordable or reasonably priced, with happy hour deals, though one found a shawarma sandwich pricey.
quotes: They have a amazing deals like $4 happy hour.
The drinks are cheap.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, welcoming staff, but others report slow, inattentive service or difficulty getting basics.
quotes: the staff is super friendly.
the service is consistently poor. Every time I've been there, the servers have been slow and inattentive

themes.label: Hookah availability
themes.text: Early reviews mention hookah as a draw, but later reviewers are disappointed that it is no longer offered.
quotes: Sad they no longer have hookah.

themes.label: Roti canai
themes.text: Roti canai with curry dipping sauce is repeatedly recommended as a standout, though one reviewer found it thinner than in Malaysia and another found it cold.
quotes: Order the roti and save some of the curry sauce to pour over your rice later.
their roti canai is the best with curry dip

themes.label: Cash-only payment
themes.text: Many reviewers warn that dining in is cash only, and some are annoyed by it, with one saying they would have given five stars otherwise.
quotes: Wouldve given 5 if they accepted credit cards
they don't take card so bring cash or bring lots of cash if you are paying for a large group

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some find staff friendly and speedy, while others report poor service, forgotten or missing dishes, rude attitude and high tip charges.
quotes: Staffs are friendly and nice, atmosphere feels comfortable.
Very bad service when we went there last week.

themes.label: Value and portions
themes.text: Reviewers describe the food as cheap or good value, with generous portions and suitability for sharing in large groups.
quotes: two dishes is more than enough for two people
Lots of good food for little $.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers mention waits in the evening, busy nights, crowded seating and being kept from seating until the whole party arrived.
quotes: And long waits in evenings. So call ahead to reserve and get there in time.
the seating is too close for comfort. It's a bit crowded in there

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the ramen rich, flavorful and among the best they've had, but a few found it bland, mediocre, salty or tedious.
quotes: Best noodle I have had, consistency, texture, and flavor. You can taste the complexity in the broth.
The ramen was kind of mediocre, which was really disappointing.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and quick, though one reviewer felt the staff had attitude.
quotes: The staff here were lovely and extremely attentive.
This place is overrated especially since the staff have attitude.

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: The small restaurant is often packed and waits can be long, though some were seated quickly or found the wait worthwhile.
quotes: I would say not to come here if you have a party of 4 or more because you will wait for a long time.
Be ready to wait for a table. But then it is worth the wait.

themes.label: Sake selection
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide variety and quality of the sake offered.
quotes: Really impressive sake selection, great ramen, really helpful staff. Come share a bottle of sake with friends.
Wide selection of sakes.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable for the quality and location, while a few call the restaurant somewhat expensive.
quotes: The food was so reasonably priced, authentic and delicious.
It is salty and expensive. Only beer is okay

themes.label: Cash-only payment
themes.text: Many reviewers warn the restaurant takes only cash, with some annoyed by the lack of notice and ATM fees, though most still enjoyed the food.
quotes: CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! CASH ONLY! (That's my only downside on this place...
Only downside is they're cash only.

themes.label: Soba and broth flavor
themes.text: Reviewers praise the soba noodles and rich, flavorful broths, especially the dipping soba and Mera Mera, though a couple found it salty, basic or oily.
quotes: The soba was clearly freshly made and the soup stock super rich in flavor.
insanely delicious and rich broth

themes.label: Japanese curry
themes.text: Most reviewers love the Japanese curry for its flavor and comfort, though one found the curry poorly cooked.
quotes: Small hole in the wall with heavenly, authentic Japanese curry.
the curry I ordered was not good

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, while others found service pushy, rushed or demanding, and one reported being ignored.
quotes: Super nice staff, really nice, cosy comfortable place, despite not looking like much from the outside.
The service is fast, but also a bit demanding for you to get in order, and get out.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Opinions split: some find prices reasonable and portions large, while others call it overpriced or say portions were small and left them hungry.
quotes: Tasty, if overpriced. Good vegan options.
those bowls are massive. Whatever you order, always get the large.

themes.label: Takoyaki quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the takoyaki the best in the city, while a few find it dry, not crispy, short on octopus or served cold.
quotes: You're not going to get better takoyaki in NYC, period.
Pretty overpriced for average takoyaki. The skin was very dry and cake like.

themes.label: Okonomiyaki and taiyaki
themes.text: Okonomiyaki and taiyaki get praise from some, but others found okonomiyaki mushy, undercooked or bland and taiyaki microwaved or not very good.
quotes: Not the best okonomiyaki I've had :( the batter was undercooked and under flavored.

themes.label: Tiny space, no seating
themes.text: The place is small with little or no seating, only a bench outside, suiting takeout; some liked the roomier new location.
quotes: Beware - nowhere to sit, so might not be the best place to eat when its freezing outside.
The new location has been a lot more spacious and offers a little bit more selection

themes.label: Service and waits
themes.text: Reviewers disagree: some describe friendly, fresh made-to-order food with modest waits, others report rude staff, long waits, running out of ingredients and early kitchen closing.
quotes: front staff are rude and terrible.
the staff is incredibly friendly, especially for such a pop-in on-the-go kind of place.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call the food cheap or reasonable, while others say takoyaki, drinks or the card minimum make it pricey.
quotes: Great spot for grabbing takoyaki and okonomiyaki at reasonable prices.
Beverages are overpriced. Food is decently priced.

themes.label: Service quality and attentiveness
themes.text: Reviewers split: some praise helpful, quick staff, while many describe rude, inattentive or hard-to-reach servers, with language barriers noted.
quotes: You have to literally chase down condescending wait staff for water, bill, etc...
Good food, good service - they care to give you the hot ones.

themes.label: Dim sum food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the dim sum as tasty and authentic, naming shrimp dumplings, rice rolls, pork buns and chicken feet, though a few found it merely okay.
quotes: Bok-choy and seafood bites are my favorites. Pork buns are succulent. And great prices.
Very good Chinese food. Delicious shrimp dumplings.

themes.label: Huge noisy dining hall
themes.text: The enormous banquet-style room with carts is seen as fun and atmospheric by many, but others find it too loud and crowded.
quotes: My non Chinese friends are always shocked by the enormous space here. Come for the atmosphere.
Too loud, and big. More of a party hall than a restaurant.

themes.label: Weekend waits and crowds
themes.text: Reviewers advise arriving early because weekends and late mornings bring crowds and waits of up to an hour or longer.
quotes: Make sure to arrive after 1 or before 10 to get seated quickly or you may have to wait up to an hour
The wait can be a little long on weekends. Come early and you won't wait that long.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Most reviewers find prices affordable and good value, though one noted a higher price than nearby places and another a changing lunch discount and pricing.
quotes: Paid $40 for 11 dishes and that was a perfect lunch a party of 4!
Great place. I come here from long, long time. Super affordable

themes.label: Steak quality and taste
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the steak as tasty, tender, high quality and cooked to order, though a few found it mediocre or inconsistently cooked.
quotes: Tender steak, reasonably priced.
Tasty cuts of meat cooked to your liking.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many reviewers call the steak cheap or good value for the quality, though one found $80 for under a pound not worth it.
quotes: Great steaks at affordable prices.
12oz Ribeye and two glasses of wine ran me around $40

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, helpful, quick staff, while others report slow service, being ignored, confusing ordering or rude treatment.
quotes: Great service and awesome steak.
The service was really inefficient and very slow.

themes.label: Standing and seating setup
themes.text: Reviewers split on the stand-up concept: some find it fun and note seats exist, others dislike standing or the cramped shared tables.
quotes: the standing idea was a fun experience
the stand-up eating still a stupid idea to me~

themes.label: Garlic rice and sauces
themes.text: Reviewers recommend the garlic rice and the Ikinari sauce, though several warn the steak sauce is salty and easily mistaken for water.
quotes: Their special Ikinari sauce is super addictive and goes really well on both the steak and rice
The sauce is salty so be careful.

themes.label: Authenticity of Malaysian food
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food authentic and reminiscent of home, but some Malaysian-experienced diners find flavours not quite right or underwhelming.
quotes: the most authentic Nasi Lemak you can find in NYC
The dishes honestly lacked in soul, it didn't have the flavours and spices of Malaysia.

themes.label: Nasi lemak quality
themes.text: Nasi lemak is often praised as a signature dish, but some found it ordinary, with too little or poor sambal.
quotes: Nasi lemak is A+, ondeh2 is a tad too mushy but still darn good
Ordered their Nasi Lemak only to be disappointed by both the taste and portion of their sambal.

themes.label: Coffee, teh tarik and drinks
themes.text: Coffee and teh tarik are often praised as excellent, though some found the tea weak and drinks watered down.
quotes: The food was good, but their coffee.. Their coffee was EXCELLENT!
The tea was weak and not sweet enough compared to the tea I am used to in Malaysia and Singapore.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, helpful, quick service, but others report silent or inattentive staff and a long wait to be served.
quotes: The staff is so friendly and helpful if you are not sure what to order.
I was seated but ignored for service for 30 minutes.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers often call prices reasonable and affordable, while others find the portions small or the cost high for what you get.
quotes: The portions are good for the price and the desserts are excellent.
Flavours were not balanced and portions very small.

themes.label: Shaved ice and bingsu
themes.text: Reviewers praise the customizable, shareable shaved ice, especially the black sesame OG, though one found the shaved ice an epic fail and another said portions shrank.
quotes: it offers the best shaved ice (papbingsu) in Manhattan. Most places require you to get sweet red beans as part of the dish.
The OG black sesame is spectacular. Plenty to share for 2-3 people.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Many reviewers say the place is very busy, loud and hard to find a seat in, so it is poor for quiet conversation.
quotes: Really love the desserts and all but it's way too noisy and crowded.
You won't have a quiet, relaxing tea time here.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices fair and portions shareable, while others call it pricy, and one says the size shrank over the years.
quotes: Super yummy dessert options for reasonable prices.
The size definitely went down over the years for the same price.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive staff, but early reviews report confused waiters, a forgotten dessert and slow service.
quotes: staff are friendly and very attentive.
The waiters were totally lost couldn't understand that some of us wants to pay with cash.

themes.label: Teas and coffee drinks
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the specialty teas, milk teas and lattes, including lavender and rose flavors.
quotes: The rose petal milk tea and lavender milk tea were so good... probably the best tea I ever had.
The tapioca quality is amazing and the lattes are very strong.

themes.label: Ramen flavor and broth
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the ramen, especially the rich, flavorful broth and noodles, though a few found the broth bland, too salty or the dish a miss.
quotes: Ramen was so incredibly delicious, the best broth I've ever tasted and not too salty.
Tonkatsu was awful. Flavorless broth. Expensive. Would not recommend.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report slow service, forgotten or mixed-up orders, and distracted staff.
quotes: Amazingly delicious, adorable atmosphere, extremely friendly staff.
service seemed very distracted and slow while I was there. It took people a while to get the waiters attention

themes.label: Atmosphere and small space
themes.text: Reviewers like the cozy, hip atmosphere, but note the space is small, tight and can get crowded.
quotes: Great food and atmosphere. Very small space though.
Great ramen but small so groups of more than two are not easily accommodated.

themes.label: Waiting times
themes.text: Some waited long for a table or food, while others found the wait short or worth it.
quotes: The 3 bowls of ramen and 2 edemame took approximately 90 minutes to order, prepare, serve and eat
Definitely worth the wait!

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Reviewers appreciate the vegetarian and vegan ramen choices, though one found the vegan ramen too salty.
quotes: glad to see there is a growing selection of vegan / veg friendly offerings

themes.label: BBQ pork buns
themes.text: Baked BBQ pork buns are the most praised dish, called the best item, sweet and buttery, though some say the rest of the food is weaker.
quotes: The pork buns are really, really good - they're like donuts! - but the rest of the food is barely edible.
The baked BBQ pork buns are the best, IMO.

themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many report waits of an hour or two that some found not worth it, while others said it was worth it or waited little.
quotes: Good dim sum, but not worth a hour and a half wait.
There is usually a long wait, but it's worth it.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices fair or cheap for Manhattan, while others call it pricey with small portions and say Chinatown offers more for less.
quotes: Truly excellent dim sum at a reasonable price

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some praise friendly, fast, attentive staff, while others report rude hosts, order errors, slow dishes and being asked to leave.
quotes: Great food friendly staff. Good for groups.
Ridiculous wait time and hostess was rude.

themes.label: Smells and cleanliness
themes.text: A few reviewers reported unpleasant smells in the restaurant, resembling cats or waste, though one called the place clean.
quotes: The whole restaurant smelt like dirty pipe or waste or leakage
it kind of smelled like cats??

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the ramen as tasty and some of the city's best, but a few find it average, lacking flavor or not memorable.
quotes: Some of the best ramen I've had in the city.
the ramen itself is not memorable

themes.label: Combo deals and prices
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the low prices and the lunch, dinner and happy hour combos that bundle ramen, an appetizer, a drink and mochi.
quotes: Their dinner special includes everything you could possibly want for $17
Great everyday ramen, superb value.

themes.label: Service speed and staff
themes.text: Many describe fast, friendly service, though some report rude or inattentive staff, a mishandled allergy request and an unacknowledged takeout order.
quotes: Fast service excellent food and warm helpful staff
you won't have to deal with the obnoxious staff

themes.label: Small cozy space
themes.text: The restaurant is described as tiny and crowded with tight seating, though many find it cozy, clean and authentic in feel.
quotes: It's small so be aware of the tight seating.
Small, clean and cozy environment.

themes.label: Pork buns and appetizers
themes.text: Pork buns, karaage and dumplings are often singled out as delicious, though one reviewer found the pork buns a bit dry.
quotes: Order the pork buns! They are to die for.
The pork bun appetizer was a bit dry

themes.label: Free banchan and side dishes
themes.text: Reviewers praise the generous, varied complimentary side dishes, including the small fried fish, and note that staff refill them.
quotes: You get lots of little dishes complimentary, like kimchi and dried fish.
I like the variety of the banchan and that servers proactively replenish them.

themes.label: Soft tofu soup quality
themes.text: The soondubu and tofu stews are the most praised dishes, though a few find the soup average, sweet or lacking depth.
quotes: The tofu pot is outstandingly delicious, and the cold noodles are also the best.
Really good soontubu! It was creamy and regular spicy was just the right level.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, attentive staff, but others report slow attention, impatience, unkind or lacking service.
quotes: they do their best to accommodate every customer
But service is so bad that I do not want to go again.

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Peak times bring lines and full rooms, though several reviewers say the wait is short or well managed.
quotes: The lines can be long at peak times, but it's worth the wait.
it is very well managed with bipers and a low waiting time compared to the number of people

themes.label: Portions and price
themes.text: Most find portions large and prices reasonable, while a few call it pricey or poor value for some dishes.
quotes: Lots of food for a very reasonable price.
It is a bit pricey. Be prepared to spend almost $30 per person.

themes.label: Creative, tasty desserts
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the desserts as creative, unique and delicious, though a few say they look better than they taste or were only okay.
quotes: Dessert is truly more an art than science and spot proves it over and over again !!!
Desserts don't taste as good as they look

themes.label: Long waits, small space
themes.text: Reviewers often describe a tiny, cramped, busy room with waits for a table, though many say the wait is worth it.
quotes: Great and unique food, but be prepared for a long wait time!
sometimes it gets packed but it is well worth the wait

themes.label: Friendly, quick staff service
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly, polite and fast, but one reviewer felt rushed to pay and leave.
quotes: The server (Lily L) was very polite and she was serving us with a big smile

themes.label: Matcha lava cake
themes.text: The matcha chocolate lava cake is repeatedly singled out as a standout dessert, though one reviewer wanted it hotter.
quotes: Matcha chocolate lava cake is one of the best desserts I've ever had

themes.label: Sweetness and price
themes.text: Some find the desserts too sweet or pricey, while others say they are not overly sweet and are affordable, especially the tapas sets.
quotes: Too me, their desserts are too sweet in general.
how they are not overwhelmingly sweet

themes.label: Meat quality and food
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the high-quality meat and flavorful food, though a few found dishes under-seasoned, bland or oily.
quotes: Very high quality meat which for a BBQ dedicated joint is all you really need.
The beef is so oily I felt like I was drinking oil.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, attentive and fast, often cooking and cutting meat at the table, with a few noting service felt rushed or unwelcoming.
quotes: The wait staff were friendly while efficiently working at a fast pace.
Service is quick, but at times feels too quick.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many find it expensive for the portion size, though several say the quality makes the price worth paying.
quotes: Pricey but worth it.
Great meat and a fun local experience but vastly overpriced

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Reviewers report long lines, especially on weekends, with most saying the food is worth waiting for and some frustrated by the wait.
quotes: Busy yes, but worth the wait.
Pretty good food but not quite worth the loooooong wait.

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Most enjoy the lively, market-like decor and atmosphere, but one reviewer found the music too loud and the seating uncomfortable.
quotes: The decor inside feels like you're eating outside on the streets of Korea.
They play bad music too loud so you can't talk.

themes.label: Udon noodle texture
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the udon noodles as chewy, fresh, handmade-tasting and perfectly textured, often calling them the best udon in NYC.
quotes: these are perfectly al dente. They have a wonderful spring to them that makes each bite such a joy.
Udon noodles have a great texture - chewy and soft.

themes.label: Small cramped space, waits
themes.text: The room is described as small, cozy and minimalist, but also cramped, with waits and no reservations; some still find it worth it.
quotes: Very small place though, they pack you in like sardines.
No reservations but worth a 20 min wait.

themes.label: Broth flavor
themes.text: Broths are described as flavorful and well balanced, not too salty or greasy, though one reviewer found the curry broth heavy and salty.
quotes: Each broth is perfectly balanced. Nothing too greasy or salty.
The soup broth is extremely flavorful and there is a wide variety on the menu.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Some found staff friendly and polite, while others reported rude employees, poor service, or a mishandled waitlist.
quotes: Everyone that works there was so polite and friendly.
Not tasty at all. One of the employees is very rude

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Reviewers warn the restaurant takes only cash, though several note an ATM is available inside.
quotes: Raku is cash only, but it's definitely worth the trip to an ATM.

themes.label: Flavorful noodles and mixian
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the noodle and mixian bowls as delicious and flavorful, with Grandma chicken mixian singled out, though a few found some bowls bland.
quotes: the grandma chicken soup is unmatched anywhere.
Ordered the Grandma's Chicken Mixian which was fantastic very tasty.

themes.label: No-tipping policy
themes.text: Reviewers like that tips are included in menu prices and no tipping is needed, seeing it as fair.
quotes: I LOVE that there's no tipping because ownership pays their employees.
Reasonable prices, certainly since tips are included in the menu prices, so no need to tip additionally.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or low, while a few say portions are small or items cost extra, making it pricey.
quotes: Seriously tasty, very low prices.
Noodle portions are on the smaller side you'll want an appetizer and maybe an extra order of noodles

themes.label: Service quality and speed
themes.text: Many praise friendly, efficient staff, but some report slow or rude service and one noted missed details.
quotes: Service was very friendly.
Good food but the service is really really slow

themes.label: Appetizers and small plates
themes.text: Appetizers such as ghost chicken, wontons, Chinese broccoli and dumplings are repeatedly praised as tasty.
quotes: We ordered the won tons and Chinese broccoli appetizer and I would have been happy with 3 more orders of each for dinner!

themes.label: Rotating guest ramen chefs
themes.text: Reviewers like that guest chefs and menus change every few weeks, calling it a fresh, adventurous concept, though one notes no guarantee of liking the menu.
quotes: it features different chefs on a rotating basis which means it's never a dull menu and always delicious
They always change the menu and never disappointed.

themes.label: Standing-only tiny space
themes.text: The shop has about ten standing spots and no chairs; some accept it as part of the experience, while others find it uncomfortable or limiting.
quotes: Wonderful ramen. Would get a five if you could sit down.
Don't expect to linger around, like the ramen shops in Japan it's just to eat and go.

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Many reviewers report long waits, from one to over two hours, with some saying it was worth it and others not.
quotes: The wait is ridiculous, the host is a total space case that will forget that you've been waiting outside for an hour
Waited 2 and a half hours to get inside. (It was a Saturday.) Once in, though, it was worth it.

themes.label: Ramen taste and broth
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the ramen as delicious, with flavorful broth and good noodles, though a few found the broth too salty or the meat tough.
quotes: The broth was flavorful, and well seasoned.
Broth was extremely thick and salty

themes.label: Price for value
themes.text: Some call the prices decent or low, while others find the ramen pricey or overpriced for what they got.
quotes: The ramen has good quality and the cook is very nice. But a little overpriced.
Rotating invited ramen chefs with a low price. Pretty damned great.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food, naming dishes such as mac and cheese, calamari, scallops, lamb shank and shakshuka, though a few found it underwhelming.
quotes: The portions were generous and the scallops were PERFECTLY done!
The macaroni & cheese is legit!

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe a relaxed, vibrant, rustic neighborhood vibe with good music and distinctive decor.
quotes: Very inviting and vibrant atmosphere.
Relaxed atmosphere and chill music.

themes.label: Drinks and happy hour
themes.text: Cocktails, margaritas and cheap happy hour deals are widely liked, though one reviewer found the happy hour house wine poor and another had warm beer.
quotes: Happy hour has great prices on drinks.
Cheap happy hour, good food but warm beer

themes.label: Service and waiting time
themes.text: Many find the staff friendly, but others report slow service, long waits and poor handling of problems.
quotes: Service is friendly but can be a bit understaffed and slow.
Food was tasty but food took 45 minutes

themes.label: Tight seating space
themes.text: A few reviewers mention the small room and tiny tables make seating cramped.
quotes: space to eat is super tight soo its kind of awkward

themes.label: Service quality and attentiveness
themes.text: Some find staff friendly, prompt and attentive, while others report slow or ignored requests, wrong orders, rushing near the time limit, and unhelpful or arrogant staff.
quotes: Service on the other hand horrendous.
attentive service without being intrusive

themes.label: All-you-can-eat price and value
themes.text: Reviewers mostly describe the fixed all-you-can-eat price as fair or good value, especially for Manhattan, though a few find it not cheap or not cost-effective.
quotes: Bbq all you can eat was pretty good for its price.
Pricing is very decent and food is definitely fresh and tasty esp for Manhattan rent.

themes.label: Food freshness and quality
themes.text: Many praise fresh, tasty, good-quality meats and ingredients, though some found the meat too thick or fatty, or the food not very fresh.
quotes: Generous with the food, which was fresh.
The meat is too thick.

themes.label: Broth choices and flavor
themes.text: Reviewers like the variety of broths, such as curry, tomato and ma la, but some found certain broths watery, bland or not spicy enough.
quotes: They have a variety of broths to choose from.
The vegetable one is extremely bland tasting.

themes.label: Waiting for a table
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits because the place is crowded, and note that reservations are only accepted for large parties.
quotes: I have never seen this place NOT crowded
you can't make reservation if your group is less than 6

themes.label: Soup dumplings
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the soup dumplings as among the best around, though a few 2018 reviews say they were not being served.
quotes: The soup dumplings do rival the ones you find in Chinatown.
only to be told by a rude waiter that they do NOT make xiao long bao dumplings

themes.label: Service and speed
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast service, while others report rude or indifferent staff and a bad policy.
quotes: the waitstaff are friendly, attentive and actually know about the food they serve!

quotes: Although some of decorations are a bit obscene, the selection of dishes is great.
I am uncomfortable with the sexual pictures and moods on the wall.

themes.label: Free cotton candy
themes.text: Guests like being given sugar or a machine to make their own cotton candy at the end of the meal.
quotes: At the end you get to make cotton candy!!!
On the plus side, you get free cotton candy at the end!

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and authentic, but others find it only decent or middling, and a few say it tasted bad.
quotes: food is middling to great pending on dish ordered
Food is not delicious at all.

themes.label: Soup dumplings
themes.text: Soup dumplings are the most praised item and the main reason to visit, though a few say they tear easily or are not the best.
quotes: Best soup dumpling ever, be sure to try the one with pork and crab!
The soup dumplings were tasty but it easily broke and stuck to the bottom.

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: Reviewers expect crowds and a wait for a table, though some say the line or turnover moves quickly.
quotes: Great food be prepared to wait for table.
the line moved really quickly

themes.label: Shared tables
themes.text: Strangers are seated together at large round tables; some found it a fun experience, others disliked it.
quotes: Had to have a share table, which was my first, but ended being a great experience.
table sharing with strangers, no special requests or deviation from menu

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many describe fast, efficient, friendly service, while others report unfriendly staff, terrible service or billing problems.
quotes: Very good, fast service, friendly waiters.
Food is good overall but not authentic. Terrible, terrible service.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly warn that the restaurant accepts only cash and no cards, which some find unfriendly.
quotes: And cash only is not customer friendly either.
Cash only, so beware.

themes.label: Dim sum quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the dim sum as delicious, authentic and among the city's best, though some call it average or mediocre, or say west coast versions are better.
quotes: Best dimsum place in the city.
low quality ingredients and low talent chefs/kitchen staff equals bad dim sum

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many reviewers describe poor, slow or rude service, with ignored requests and feeling rushed, though a few found the staff friendly or helpful.
quotes: Worst service ever, just go to Jin Fong instead.
the service was so horrible to us we left after wasting almost 20 minutes with no assistance

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits and a crowded, busy room, especially at weekends, and often advise arriving early.
quotes: Show up early or expect a wait.
The wait could be long, and quite frankly it is a bit of a contest of sorts.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some reviewers call prices good, cheap or reasonable, while others find the restaurant a little expensive.
quotes: Good dim sum at a decent price!
Great dim sum even though a little on the pricey side

themes.label: Piggy buns and desserts
themes.text: The pig-shaped custard buns and other sweet items such as durian pastry and egg tarts are described as cute and delicious.
quotes: The lai wong bao (yellow sweet paste inside) is the piggy bun which is super cute and great for a foodie.

themes.label: High prices for portions
themes.text: Many reviewers found dishes expensive for the small portions, though a few felt the quality justified the cost.
quotes: it felt $9 too expensive for the portion of food
Price vs. Value proposition is not there but it was nice to experience it at least once with friends and family.

themes.label: Steak mazemen
themes.text: The steak mazemen was often praised as tender, savory and the dish to order, though one reviewer found it too salty and another too sweet.
quotes: Her steak makemen was terrific - savory and perfectly tender.
The beef was very tender and seasoned very well.

themes.label: Small communal seating, waits
themes.text: Seating is a tight communal table with few seats, causing waits, though some found it cozy and arrived without waiting.
quotes: There are only 14 seats, so get there early!
Cute and cozy nook in the east side of LES

themes.label: Uni toast and appetizers
themes.text: Appetizers, especially the uni toast, were commonly praised, though one reviewer thought the uni was low grade and small.
quotes: they are super generous with the portion of the uni they give
The uni toast is okay, not exactly super creamy.

themes.label: Friendly service
themes.text: Servers were described as friendly, attentive and quick, with only a few complaints about a missed waitlist and unprofessional kitchen conduct.
quotes: Really friendly server and really good food.
Good noodles.. great service. Even took us in just as they were closing.

themes.label: Ramen and broth quality
themes.text: Many praise rich broth and well-cooked noodles, while others find the ramen salty, bland or average, and some say quality declined over time.
quotes: The best broth I had in ramen, feels like it is healing your body
the soup base wasn't very flavorful and almost bitter

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are often described as friendly, polite and fast, but several reviewers report rude treatment, slow checks, or pressure over tips.
quotes: Very polite and speedy service.
I was told I couldn't eat their food in their restaurant. Which was empty.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or affordable, but others cite price increases, small portions, or a bowl not worth what they paid.
quotes: The flavors are consistent and it's very affordable.
Definitely doesn't worth the amount I paid for.

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly note the restaurant is tiny, cramped or small, though some accept this alongside good food.
quotes: My heart wants to give it 5 stars, but my only issue is the size of the establishment; so small.

themes.label: Redecor and menu changes
themes.text: Some longtime customers say the place changed, with new furniture, a different menu, and a loss of authentic feel.
quotes: The menu has changed, less options and pricier.
Now, it looks like a cheap rip off of some hipster place.

themes.label: Udon noodle quality
themes.text: Reviewers praise the udon, especially the chewy, fresh noodles and flavorful broth, with several calling it the best in New York; a few find it less good than the original.
quotes: Best udon in Manhattan. Noodles are the proper thickness and consistency. Broth is satisfying and properly seasoned.
Udon was delicious, very different from what we had in NYC. It's fresh and not heavy while still very tasty

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive, welcoming staff, though a few report mistakes, too few staff, slow ordering, or a bill that was not split.
quotes: Very efficient and friendly staff too.
The main reason is that the number of the staff is not enough.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable for the quality and portions good, while others say dishes were overpriced, portions small, or that a la carte items add up.
quotes: Portions and soup to noodle ratio are worth the price.
Ankimo is overpriced for its portion.

themes.label: Wait and reservations
themes.text: Reviewers note waits of 30 to 45 minutes at busy times, recommend reserving, and some say the wait is worth it.
quotes: Would recommend to reserve a place in the peak hours; otherwise a 45min wait might be probable.
raku is worth the wait.

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the minimalist, wood-accented, cozy space, though one finds it too noisy for conversation.
quotes: Loved the atmosphere, the wood accents really made me feel like I was in Japan.
Environment is terrible for chatting with friends - way too much noise.

themes.label: Food quality and authenticity
themes.text: Most reviewers praise fresh, authentic Ivorian dishes, especially grilled fish and stews, but a few report hard meat, old fish or declining quality.
quotes: The food is simply fantastic, makes you feel like your in ivory coast
the care that they used to take with the food, no longer exists

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many describe friendly, quick, courteous service, while others report rude or unwelcoming staff, especially at the front counter.
quotes: Quick friendly service, huge servings, delicious fresh meat.
This lady at the front is rude and inconsiderate

themes.label: Portions and prices
themes.text: Most find portions large and prices fair or affordable, though a few call the food somewhat expensive or overpriced.
quotes: Prices are definitely fair, and the food portions are fantastic.
Food little expensive but very good

themes.label: Cleanliness, noise and building
themes.text: Reviewers mention dirt, a cockroach, dirty restrooms, loud patrons, a run-down room and a lack of heating in winter.
quotes: This place is very dirty, I saw a cockroach
the place is freezing cold during winter

themes.label: Open 24/7
themes.text: Reviewers value that the restaurant is open around the clock, including late at night.
quotes: I like that they are open 24/7.

themes.label: Authentic Japanese comfort food
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the food as authentic, traditional Japanese home-style cooking that goes beyond sushi, with several dishes singled out as especially good.
quotes: A traditional Japanese food place that changed my perspective of what Japanese food is.
Best home-style Japanese food in the city

themes.label: Waiting times and crowds
themes.text: Waits and crowding are common, and some say the wait is worthwhile, while others found it too long or the food slow to arrive.
quotes: Not worth to wait for 1hour. I would find another place if there is long wait.
they have a good system in place so you van wander off in Times Square and just get a text when the table is almost ready

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Some find prices fair and the no-tipping approach good value, but others call the food expensive for small portions.
quotes: A $26 dish like chicken katsu doesn't fill he stomach.
awesome tastes for awesome price

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe attentive, efficient, friendly service and like the no-tipping policy, though a few reported poor or unfriendly service.
quotes: excellent, fresh food and warm, attentive service

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, naming dishes such as the stews, bulgogi, pork belly, pancakes and fried chicken, though a few find it average or inauthentic.
quotes: Best Korean food in Midtown! Loved every dish.
Loved the dishes here... so flavorful and unique. definitely get the fried chicken and the sesame ice cream.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff are described as friendly, helpful and efficient, even when the restaurant is busy.
quotes: They are sooo friendly and make fantastic suggestions.
In a super busy place, service is very friendly and super efficient.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find it overpriced or not worth the cost, while others praise lunch deals, portions and say quality justifies the price.
quotes: Food is great but it's overpriced.
For $20, I would definitely say that the portions are worth it.

themes.label: Long waits and crowds
themes.text: The restaurant is very busy, with waits of up to an hour, no reservations, and crowds that put off some visitors.
quotes: Long wait though (one hour) so plan ahead. They don't take reservations.
I think it was 20 ~ 30 minutes wait, but I had to wait 50 minutes.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the cute, cozy, modern decor and inviting atmosphere, although a couple say it is loud or noisy.
quotes: Nice atmosphere, although a bit loud.
The atmosphere is a very nice and rustic feel and the staff is super nice as well

themes.label: Watermelon soju
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the watermelon soju served in a watermelon as a signature drink, though a few find it watered down, too sweet or overhyped.
quotes: Two words: Watermelon soju. You must get it. Served in a half watermelon, it tastes like candy. Awesome.
It was a little watered down, and the soju definitely overpowered the whatever little watermelon juice was in there.

themes.label: Staff service and attitude
themes.text: Many reviewers describe unfriendly, rude or slow staff, with some noting favouritism toward Korean speakers, though a few found staff friendly and attentive.
quotes: Waiters' attitude is horrible, strongly suggest don't go to this shity place.
If you speak Korean they seem to be more attentive.

themes.label: Budae jjigae and stews
themes.text: Reviewers frequently praise the army stew and other stews as the highlight dishes, often shared among groups.
quotes: Always amazing Budae jjigae, raspberry wine is on the pricey side.
Their soups are unbelievable!

themes.label: Long waits
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits at peak times, with some saying the wait was worth it and others describing very long delays.
quotes: And 1.5 hrs later I get a text to reply within 5 mins if I still wanted to eat.

themes.label: Automatic tip and payment
themes.text: Several reviewers complain that tips of 20% are added automatically, and that cards are not accepted or cash discounts are offered.
quotes: can someone tell me why we got charged of 20% of the tip by the restaurant?

themes.label: Beef noodle soup quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the Taiwanese beef noodle soup, citing tender beef, rich bone marrow broth and good noodles, with several calling it the best in the city.
quotes: Beef noodle soup is amazing. Tender beef, lovely broth.
The beef shanks are so tender and flavorful, the broth is full of delicious beef broth, and the noodles are springy and perfect.

themes.label: Tiny space and waits
themes.text: Reviewers say the restaurant seats only about 8 to 11 people, so waits can be long and groups are hard to seat.
quotes: the space is tiny, fitting about 9 people at once-- there can be a long wait just because there is extremely limited seating
this place is tiny so expect a wait during peak hours especially with a group more than two people

themes.label: Price and portion size
themes.text: Several reviewers find the bowls expensive or small for the money, though a few say the price is reasonable.
quotes: definitely not worth the price. The basic option without anything added is $14.50 + tax + tips. Simply adding spice would be another $2.
for the price coupled with the fact that the amount of soup is laughably small-smaller than any food spot I have ever been too-I would never go back

themes.label: Friendly staff and owner
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff and the chef-owner as friendly and welcoming, though one reviewer complains about the host and another about service.
quotes: Chef is really friendly to chat to and brought us extras.
Staff is polite, friendly, and efficient.

themes.label: Taiwanese breakfast items
themes.text: Reviewers like the soy milk, mi jiang drinks and radish cakes, but others found the breakfast food salty, stale, overpriced or not worth a trip.
quotes: The beverages are the best part! The mee jiang, peanuts with rice milk, was delicious hot.
Egg Bing was too salty, and fried bread stick (you tiao) was stale.

themes.label: Dumplings quality
themes.text: Dumplings, especially fried or pan-fried pork ones, are repeatedly called the best in the city, flavourful and crispy.
quotes: This place has the best dumplings I have ever had. I got the pan fried which were perfectly crispy and tender.
Great dumplings at an unbelievably low price. The noodle soup were forgettable.

themes.label: Low prices
themes.text: Reviewers find prices very cheap for the generous portions, such as 8 to 12 dumplings for a few dollars.
quotes: 10 dumplings, pan fried or steamed for three bucks.
At $4 for an order of 8 dumplings and $8 for a bowl of noodle soup, you get alot of food for a reasonable price.

themes.label: Hand-pulled noodles and soups
themes.text: Many praise the chewy hand-pulled noodles, while others find the noodle soups bland, dry or forgettable.
quotes: The hand pulled noodles are chewy good.
The noodle soup was bad. It tastes as plain as it looks.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Some describe quick, fast service, while others report rude or poor service and a forgotten order.
quotes: Super affordable, excellent tasting, fast service.
The waitress was rude and forgot our order, we didn't get water or our drinks until we had asked

themes.label: Cleanliness and space
themes.text: The room is described as a small, no-frills hole in the wall; some say it is clean, others report dirt and smelly bathrooms.
quotes: This is a bare bones place that is clean and has amazing food.
Bathroom needs to be cleaned better, or customers need to be cleaner - smells.

themes.label: Fresh crisp seaweed and fish
themes.text: Reviewers praise very fresh fish, crisp warm seaweed and well-made rice, with hand rolls made in front of them.
quotes: The seaweed was perfectly warm and crisp and the sushi is hand rolled right in front of you.
Crispy seaweed, warm rice and fresh fish.

themes.label: Waiting in line
themes.text: Many report lines or long waits at busy times, though most say the line moves fast and is worth it, while one says it is not.
quotes: Prepare to wait in line which is torture when you're hungry, but it's well worth the wait.
Tasty rolls, but I would not say the long lines are worth it.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Most find prices affordable and tip-inclusive for the quality, but a few call it pricey or overpriced.
quotes: Prices are very decent and includes the tip.
We got 3 sushi hand rolls for $20.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most praise friendly, quick and attentive service, though one reviewer found the staff rude.
quotes: The chefs behind the counter are attentive and watching when to serve you the next roll.
The staff were rude.

themes.label: Overhyped, underwhelming food
themes.text: A few reviewers found the rolls good but not special, forgettable or too salty compared with the high ratings.
quotes: Nothing wrong with this place but nothing special either. I'm baffled by the great reviews.
It's over hyped but if you're really hankering for some half decent hand rolls you could do worse.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the staff as friendly, welcoming and helpful, with service often called great.
quotes: Very friendly service and extremly good food. easy odering and payment.
The staff here is friendly, courteous and they made me feel welcome.

themes.label: Slow food and long waits
themes.text: Several reviewers report waits of an hour or more for food, pick-up, delivery or seating, though others found service quick.
quotes: Super slow station... Waited like more than one hour for food.
After waiting an hour for a pick-up delivery, I was told it would be another 20 minutes.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find the ramen well priced for the portions, while others say it is expensive or that prices have risen without bigger portions.
quotes: the ramen is delicious and very good price!
if you're going to jack the price, jack the portions, too.

themes.label: Broth and noodle quality
themes.text: Broth is often praised as flavorful, but some reviewers criticise the noodles' texture, tough pork or a salty or overpowering broth.
quotes: The ramen was good, but the noodles let it down in my opinion. Good broth though.
they had a very strange texture, almost like strings of Play Doh

themes.label: Kiosk ordering and customization
themes.text: Reviewers like ordering by touchscreen or kiosk and customizing bowls with free extras and toppings.
quotes: I really liked the customized ordering process too, we could pick all the options we wanted.
The portions are good and the ordering system is nice.

themes.label: Dry pot flavor and quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the dry pot as delicious, spicy and authentic, though a few find it mediocre or say the flavor has slipped.
quotes: Best dry pot I've ever had. If you like authentic, spicy Chinese food, this is the place to be.
The dry pot is not even as tasty as the one I had in The Bao.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call it pricey or say costs add up quickly, while others find prices reasonable and good value.
quotes: the prices on the menu look cheap, but it all adds up very quickly.
Great food with reasonable prices.

themes.label: Customizable ingredients
themes.text: Reviewers like choosing and mixing their own ingredients and spice level, including unusual items.
quotes: I love that you can customize your dish.
Everything can be customized to your taste from the peppercorns to the ingredients.

themes.label: Service and waiting
themes.text: Some praise friendly, helpful staff, while others report long waits, slow seating, unsmiling staff or mistakes with orders.
quotes: Wait time was reasonable and the staff is amazing.
Only two waiters serving at busy lunch time. Wait time is considerably long

themes.label: Decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers like the stylish pink design and lively, cozy atmosphere, though a couple find it loud.
quotes: the place has beautiful pink design. They even have pink rice.
Very chic decor, and overall nice atmosphere.

themes.label: Japanese desserts
themes.text: Reviewers most often praise the desserts, especially black sesame creme brulee, mochi and green tea ice cream, though a few found some desserts bland or tasteless.
quotes: Everyone should try the black sesame creme brulee.
Best mochi ever!! Other desserts are good too.

themes.label: Tea selection and quality
themes.text: Many reviewers enjoyed the teas and matcha drinks, calling them excellent, soothing and varied.
quotes: A great selection of teas on the menu along with wonderful sweets and dessert to choose from
The tea was very soothing and the dessert box was beautifully put together

themes.label: Calm traditional atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a cozy, calm, authentically Japanese tea house setting, though some note the space is small and crowded.
quotes: the decor inside is calm and zen like in quality
Small but smartly designed with each space intimate to its own.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food and drinks expensive for the portions and taste, and one felt shortchanged.
quotes: I rated it 3 stars as it is a bit pricey. Green tea was expensive for a drink.
Umm, it's okay. That how I felt. So, I think it's over priced.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise kind, attentive staff, but a few mention rushing, tip requests or lack of waiting seats.
quotes: I've never been treated with such care and politeness, and amazing patience with all my questions about the menu items.
you get the sense the staff is trying to rush you out

themes.label: Soba noodle quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the soba as among the best in NYC, while a few find it unimpressive, lacking chew, soggy when hot, or overrated.
quotes: Probably one of the best soba-noodles you can get in the U.S, and one of the best place you enjoy authentic Japanese food
their soba lacked the chew. There's also a flour-y taste to it.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable and lunch or early dinner specials good value, while others find dishes pricey for small portions.
quotes: Early bird special before 7 is nice. Comes with appetizers, soba (hot/cold) OR udon, tempura, and ice cream. Very good deal.
Uni soba was $27! I don't want to pay $27 for small portion of uni soba.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the service as excellent, friendly or efficient, but two reviewers report poor or terrible service.
quotes: Authentic Japanese food, terrific service
Service is poor… the only time the waitress put on a smile is when she presented the check

themes.label: Crowds and waiting
themes.text: Reviewers say the restaurant is small and busy, with waits at peak times, especially weekends, so arriving early is advised.
quotes: if you fail to be there at the opening time on weekends, you may have to wait an hour.
It is a crowded place, so it is recommended to go a little earlier than the meal time.

themes.label: Authentic Japanese flavor
themes.text: Several reviewers feel the food is authentic and reminds them of Japan.
quotes: Smells like Japan. Tastes like Japan. If you miss Japan, come here.
Closest thing in NYC so far to being back in a soba house in Japan.

themes.label: Ramen quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the ramen, its rich broth, tender pork and spicy miso, and many call it authentic or among the best in the city.
quotes: Awesome authentic ramen that doesn't leave you an hour later with that post MSG feel.
Deep complex broth. Good kimchi. Wonderful service!

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff are repeatedly described as friendly, attentive and quick, though a couple of reviewers report inattentive service.
quotes: The service is the main reason I come as they're fast, my cup is never empty, and they're all very nice.
Wait staff inattentive, ramen salty, never brought me my beer.

themes.label: Good value and prices
themes.text: Reviewers find prices fair or low for the area and like the lunch combos, sets and happy hour deals.
quotes: If you get one of the sets, it's the same price no matter which ramen you choose!
heart-food delicious and super affordable

themes.label: Atmosphere and seating comfort
themes.text: Many like the cozy, friendly vibe, but others find the room cold, cramped or uncomfortable, with bench seating and small space.
quotes: most of the tables have benches for seats and it gets really uncomfortable sitting through the lunch.
I love the atmosphere, very nice dim setting.

themes.label: Sides and appetizers
themes.text: Pork buns, gyoza, eel tacos and other small plates are praised as extras worth ordering alongside the ramen.
quotes: they have phenomenal pork buns as well. This place has never disappointed us.
For appetizer we took the eel tacos and the dish was very appealing and the taste was even better.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the food as good or excellent, with shrimp and grits and lamb singled out, though a few found dishes disappointing.
quotes: The shrimp and grits are worth the trip!
I had the lamb it was tender and good I tasted the fettuccine it wasn't that great

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Reviewers split: some call staff friendly and attentive, while many report slow, inattentive, rude or inconsistent service and order errors.
quotes: Service was excellent, friendly, informative good interactive with us
Great food, service was lacking. Our waitress was on her iphone with the wireless earbuds the whole time.

themes.label: Live music and atmosphere
themes.text: Many enjoy the jazz, DJ and music nights and the lively, fun vibe, though one says the music change disappointed and another found it loud.
quotes: The music is Top shelf jazz the food is good what else you want
the oldschool music was one of the greatest in many years I have heard playing

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some find prices and deals good value, while others complain of small portions, overpriced drinks, unexpected charges or an entry fee.
quotes: Small portion and overpriced for watered down mimosas
For $45 you get an entree and unlimited mimosas. Pretty solid deal.

themes.label: Happy hour and drinks
themes.text: Happy hour and drink deals, including cheap beers and Martini Monday, are praised, although food choices at happy hour are called limited.
quotes: Excellent happy hour drinks, not much happy hour food.

themes.label: Happy hour specials
themes.text: Many praise the happy hour deals, especially $1 oysters, but others dislike that specials are bar-only or found the total bill too high.
quotes: this place has one of best happy hours in the union square area
You can't order happy hour items if you are sitting at the dinner table.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers describe attentive, friendly service, though a few report mistakes, slow dishes, too few servers or a spill.
quotes: The wait staff was supper attentive and always filled our glasses when they were empty.
service was pretty bad (not enough servers)

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Several find the food and drinks pricey for what they get, while others say prices are good or fair for the quality.
quotes: I usually expect bibimbap and Korean pancakes to be a lot cheaper.
Great Korean BBQ option, good price.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the fun, modern, airy space and decor, though one found it very loud.
quotes: the place is warm and modern
Conversations across the table are not feasible because of the noise level inside.

themes.label: Bibimbap and wings
themes.text: Bibimbap, including uni and stone-bowl versions, and chicken wings are frequently called tasty, though the sashimi bibimbap disappointed one reviewer.
quotes: One of the best bibimbap bowls I have ever had and I am picky!
Their wings are bomb and I really enjoy their bibimbop

themes.label: Curry laksa and roti
themes.text: Curry laksa and roti canai are repeatedly singled out as standout dishes, praised for flavor and authenticity.
quotes: Must try the Roti Canai and Curry laksa
The curry laksa won't let me forget this place!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some reviewers found staff friendly, helpful and fast, while others described service as rude, rushed, inattentive or lacking.
quotes: Fantastic food, great and very helpful service.
The service, however, is brusque and rushed, at least during lunch

themes.label: Small portions and price
themes.text: Several reviewers felt portions were small or the food was not worth the price.
quotes: Delicious food but definitely not worth it for the price.
Portions were a bit smaller than expected

themes.label: Atmosphere and crowding
themes.text: Many liked the decor and cozy, fun atmosphere, but others noted noise, cramped tables, drafts, and the need for reservations.
quotes: Good food and service, tables are small and very close together.
I really liked the ambiance and the food was good.

themes.label: Hainanese chicken
themes.text: Hainanese chicken drew a split: one reviewer loved it, while others found it dry or disappointing.
quotes: the haianese chicken is to die for.
Hainese Roasted Chicken was a bit dry

themes.label: Chewy light mochi texture
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the light, airy, chewy texture, while a few found the donuts more like ordinary cake donuts or stale.
quotes: These donuts are truly light, airy, and fluffy. The pon-de-ring shape makes this treat easy to share among a group off friends.
First bite I was hoping for that gluttony chewy texture which they lacked. Tasted more on donut side.

themes.label: Flavor variety and favorites
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the six flavors, often naming bacon miso, matcha, purple pebble, strawberry and cookies and cream as favorites.
quotes: Love the variety of flavors, there is a donut for everyone. My favorite is the Cruncha Matcha!
