themes.text: Many reviewers say the food feels genuinely Japanese, with dishes hard to find elsewhere, though a few found it only decent.
quotes: There is no Japanese-style fake that is often found in New York. The ingredients are fresh from Japan.
It's not high-falutin Japanese nouveau - it's well-executed, quality Japanese fare.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere, date spot
themes.text: The small, cozy room with sumo on TV is often called a good place for a date.
quotes: The restaurant is cozy and perfect for a date.
Fantastic authentic Japanese. Sumo on TV and delicious chanko nabe.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most praise friendly, attentive staff, though one reviewer found staff unfriendly and another wanted more servers for a big group.
quotes: great atmosphere, great staff—super attentive.
food expensive but not taste good. staffs are not friendly. never go back again.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable, while others say the bill, small portions or the food quality did not justify the cost.
quotes: The food is awesome and the price is very reasonable!
Nothing was bad, but nothing really justified the price.

themes.label: Friendly, attentive staff
themes.text: Most reviewers praise a friendly, welcoming and attentive staff, but a few describe spotty service, forgotten orders and servers who barely checked on tables.
quotes: The wait staff are all amazing, the food is tasty and the atmosphere is ideal for brunch.
However our server barely checked on us and also brought the wrong item twice.

themes.label: Cozy, laid-back atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe a cozy, calm, charming room with good vibes and music, though one says it is a bit tight on space.
quotes: Very laid-back and friendly atmosphere. Daily food and drink specials.
If you need a lot of space to eat, definitely don't go here because it is a bit tight

themes.label: Brunch dishes
themes.text: Brunch is a frequent highlight, with praise for shrimp and grits, ackee and saltfish, pancakes and jerk chicken and waffles, though some found waffles stale.
quotes: The weird but amazing combo of Jerk chicken and waffles was my favorite.
Waffle tasted a bit stale.

themes.label: Food quality and consistency
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious, but some found dishes bland, overcooked, burnt or inconsistent.
quotes: The sauce that came with shrimp was extremely bland and runny.
The food is delish and fresh.

themes.label: Drinks and pricing
themes.text: Drinks such as sorrel, rum punch and sangria earn praise, and many find prices reasonable, though one found pancakes and a drink pricey.
quotes: Rum punch is great. Had the salmon burger and it was perfect!!
The food is great and the prices are very reasonable.

themes.label: Variety of vendors and food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide range of food stalls, shops and cuisines, from groceries and meat to prepared food and coffee, all under one roof.
quotes: A conglomerate of independent stores, great grocery shopping, fish market, fruits and vegetables, meat market, breads, coffees, cheeses.
A great assortment of restaurants, and market-style shops. A great place to go and grab a bite with friends.

themes.label: Fresh produce and groceries
themes.text: Shoppers say the fruit, vegetables, meat and fish are fresh and good for everyday grocery shopping.
quotes: Excellent place to get fresh fruits and vegetables and from different countries
Fresh fruit and vegetables Meats and Seafood at great prices

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or cheaper than supermarkets, while others say the new market has become pricey, with some vendors very expensive.
quotes: It seems a bit pricier, but you can't fault them for that.
You can get lunch there for under $10 and enjoy the ambiance of the space!

themes.label: New space and seating
themes.text: Many like the new, clean, spacious building with plenty of seating, though some miss the old market and one wants more seating and bathrooms.
quotes: Great quality and huge space upstairs for sitting.
I wish they had more seating and an easy to find bathroom.

themes.label: Old market nostalgia
themes.text: Several reviewers miss the old market's character, though many are glad the community feel and vendors were largely kept.
quotes: Beautiful new space, and great to see lots of the old vendors still there!
While I love the openness of this new location, it really makes me miss the old one.

themes.label: Soul food taste
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the soul food as delicious and authentic, naming oxtails, mac and cheese, ribs and yams, though a few found it bland or tough.
quotes: the yams are unbelievably AMAZING
Everything was seasoned to perfection and required no salt nor hot sauce which I love on my greens.

themes.label: Live music and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the live band or jazz on weekends and describe a great vibe.
quotes: There is an excellent band on weekends.
On the weekends sometimes they have a singer and one or two musicians performing African American music repertoire

themes.label: Variety and buffet by weight
themes.text: Customers like the wide buffet and salad bar choices, paid by weight.
quotes: Wide selection of different foods to choose from to eat. From hot choices to cold choices
buffet with a wide selection (you pay by weight)

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many call prices cheap or reasonable, while others find it expensive, note a recent price rise, or object to a 20% card tip.
quotes: The food is delicious and the price is reasonable.
They charge a 20% tip for no reason

themes.label: Small crowded space
themes.text: The dining area and buffet are described as small, tight, hot and crowded.
quotes: The buffet area could benefit from a little more space.
the seating area is done tight

themes.label: Ramen broth and noodles
themes.text: Reviewers praise the ramen, especially the clean, rich broth, chewy noodles and tender toppings, with the kitakata ramen singled out.
quotes: Broth was delicate and not salty.
the broth is clean, noodles are chewy, and the inside of the restaurant is sleek and cool

themes.label: High prices, small portions
themes.text: Some reviewers found the bowls small and expensive for what they contained, at about $17 a bowl.
quotes: Bowls are small and expensive, and the egg isn't runny as it should be.
$17 before tip/tax for noodles and 1 piece of pork belly is not a good deal.

themes.label: Abura soba (soupless noodles)
themes.text: Opinions on the soupless noodles differ: one calls it great and another found it interesting but not amazing, while a third found it poor value.
quotes: I opted for their soupless abura-soba dish based on a recommendation, which was interesting, but not amazing.
Great Abura soba in Manhattan!

themes.label: Service and speed
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly staff and quick food, but one complained of a 20-minute wait while staff stood around chatting.
quotes: Service was solid + friendly, food came quickly.
The correct wait time after ordering ramen is under 5 minutes, not the 20 minutes it takes here

themes.label: Appetizers and sides
themes.text: Starters such as pork buns, miso gyoza, karaage and edamame earn praise, though one reviewer found the salad dressing salty.
quotes: My favorite for the night was the pork bun.
Had the miso gyoza and pork buns to start which were both excellent

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many reviewers describe the food as tasty or great, with specific praise for dishes like mac n cheese, oxtails and lollipop chicken, though a few call it mediocre.
quotes: Amazing food. The chef is on point.
food was good i had oxtails and the wine and cheese was nice too we will be back soon

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Some praise friendly, accommodating staff, while others report rude, snappy, inattentive or slow service and forgotten orders.
quotes: The staff was so accommodating and friendly.
Terrible service, we had to serve ourselves water and drink orders were forgotten and poorly made

themes.label: Disorganization at events
themes.text: Reviewers describe unorganized operations, long lines and unprepared staffing at busy brunches, parties and large group events.
quotes: Was very unorganized. On serving station. One full bar. Could have done much much better.
only 1 people serving our party of 65 asked for ginger ale and got seltzer water

themes.label: Music and entertainment
themes.text: Live jazz, DJs, open mic and dancing nights are praised as highlights of the venue.
quotes: The jazz set was awesome and the DJ which was Reg Wells in the back was an added treat
The entertainment is top-notch and the food is awesome

themes.label: Bar and drink selection
themes.text: Several reviewers complain of limited bar options, no liquor, and poorly made or disappointing drinks, though some call drinks good.
quotes: I'm not a beer & Wine person.THEY HAVE NO LIQUOR LICENSE.
Nice event need more variety at bar

themes.label: Eel rice bowls
themes.text: Eel donburi, especially the una-tama don, is repeatedly praised as tender and flavorful, though a couple of reviewers found eel dishes flat or disappointing.
quotes: By far the best unagi I've tasted in NYC.
The pieces of eel were super tender and it had a great balance of being sweet and savory.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers found the staff friendly, attentive and fast, but one reviewer felt ignored and another noted understaffing at busy times.
quotes: Staff didn't pay attention and weren't friendly. We felt like we were begging for food and drinks.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or good value, while others say portions are small and the cost adds up.
quotes: Tasty, but portions are relatively small, bumping up the price.
I had three dishes and sake with my girlfriend and the bill was around 90... Very reasonable!

themes.label: Sake and happy hour
themes.text: Reviewers like the sake selection and happy hour deals, including cheap beer with chicken and complimentary sake with scallop sashimi.
quotes: complimentary sake with the purchase of their scallop sashimi. You can order as many as you like
They also have a wonderfully curated sake list.

themes.label: Atmosphere and room
themes.text: The small, cozy, dimly lit space is described as warm and good for dates or friends, though one reviewer found it a bit dark.
quotes: It's a small cozy place, dimly lit but very cute and intimate.
although a little bit dark at there( I used my light to help me taking picture)

themes.label: Shoyu ramen with truffle
themes.text: Reviewers praise the shoyu ramen, especially its light, rich broth and the truffle that adds depth without overpowering.
quotes: The truffle added depth to the flavor of the broth but was not overpowering.
Shoyu is delicious and the broth is rich and not heavy.

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Many reviewers enjoy the vegan and vegetarian ramens, especially the spicy mushroom, and appreciate the dedicated vegan menu section.
quotes: They have a vegan section on the menu with three vegan ramens!!! I loved the spicy mushroom one.
Best vegan ramen ever and very friendly staff.

themes.label: Small space and waiting
themes.text: The shop is described as small and cozy with limited seating, and some mention waits, though most say the wait is worth it.
quotes: Small place though, be prepared to wait a few minutes if it's busy.. but so worth it.
This place is crowded and there's only one person who does everything so prepare for the wait.

themes.label: Friendly, quick service
themes.text: Staff are described as kind, attentive and efficient, with several noting quick service.
quotes: Excellent ramen place for a delicious lunch. Swift and very kind service.
A small spot but the food was delicious and staff super lovely

themes.label: Pork buns and sides
themes.text: Pork buns and other sides such as karaage are praised as exceptional or very good.
quotes: The pork bun is exceptional.
both the Ramen and Pork Buns exceeded expectations.

themes.label: Fresh, tasty rice rolls
themes.text: Most reviewers call the rice rolls fresh, delicious and authentic, with egg and pork popular, but one review found them stuck together, bland and horrible.
quotes: The best 拉肠粉/cheong fun/steamed rice roll I've ever had in my life.
The noodles are stuck together. It tastes bland and makes my tongue Yikes.

themes.label: Cheap prices
themes.text: Reviewers describe the cart as cheap and good value for the quality of food.
quotes: Super tasty and fresh cheung fun for a cheap price in the middle of Chinatown.
For a dollar fifty, you get a something hot and tasty to fill your tummy.

themes.label: Long lines of locals
themes.text: Reviewers note a steady line of locals, seen as a good sign and worth the wait, with fast service.
quotes: There was a long queue of locals waiting to buy theirs so that's definitely a great sign!
Always fresh. Always a line. Always fast and ready to go.

themes.label: Portion sizes and options
themes.text: Reviewers mention huge portions and a choice of sizes, fillings and add-ons such as egg.
quotes: Portions are regular, large and extra large.
Great food! Huge portions!

themes.label: Rude staff and managers
themes.text: Many reviewers describe rude, disrespectful employees and managers, including attitude when orders go wrong, though a few say staff were courteous or pleasant.
quotes: SO TRUE THE MANAGER IS RUDE AVOID THIS MCDONALD'S
the manager that I met there have no respect for her customer she put up an attitude at me

themes.label: Slow service and waits
themes.text: Most reviewers complain of slow staff, long lines and waits over ten minutes, but several others say service was quick or speedy.
quotes: Everytime I come I'm waiting over 10 mins for a meal
Everything was nice and fresh service was fast

themes.label: Order mistakes
themes.text: Reviewers report wrong orders, ignored sequence of orders, drinks made incorrectly and missing change.
quotes: They are slow moving and always make mistakes on your order.
they never make my ice coffee right. It always has syrup at the bottom.

themes.label: Broken ice cream machines
themes.text: Reviewers say the ice cream or milkshake machine is never working, with other equipment also broken or unavailable, and one found spoiled ice cream.
quotes: Ice cream machine never working - and I need a milkshake!
always something broke or not available

themes.label: Not open 24 hours
themes.text: Reviewers say the restaurant advertises 24 hours but is closed, or ignores customers at night, or closes early for a party.
quotes: It says 24 hour but it's closed .
Don't say that this place is open 24 hours when I'm literally standing here

themes.label: Dipping soba and broth
themes.text: Reviewers mostly praise the soba and its flavorful broths, especially the dipping versions such as kimchi pork, stamina and mera mera, though a few found it salty or merely above average.
quotes: The broth was AMAZING. The noodles were pretty great too, but wow, the broth was some of the best I've had.
If you follow it correctly, you'll be rewarded with one of the best noodle dishes in NYC

themes.label: Small cramped space
themes.text: The restaurant is repeatedly described as tiny and cramped, with small tables and possible waits, though some find it cozy.
quotes: The tables themselves are small, too; we could barely fit our food and the bottle of sparkling sake
We struggled to fit with a baby stroller here, but they made it happen!

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Some found staff friendly and polite, while others reported rude, untrained or slow service, missed orders and a language barrier.
quotes: the staff was so polite and welcoming.
we waited almost 40 mins for two soba noodles. The people who came after us got their noodles before us.

themes.label: Vegan and vegetarian options
themes.text: Vegans and vegetarians appreciate the wide choice of meat-free dishes on the menu.
quotes: So many varieties for vegetarians/vegans.
big variety in vegan dishes.

themes.label: Cash only payment
themes.text: Several reviewers warn that the restaurant takes only cash and does not accept cards, which one called weird.
quotes: Ensure to have cash as they do not accept cards, pretty weird.
This place is cash only, but there's an ATM a few doors down if you need to use it.

themes.label: Rude, poor service
themes.text: Many reviewers describe unfriendly, pushy or rude staff, tip pressure and extra charges, though a few found service efficient or friendly.
quotes: The guy just threw a menu abruptly on our table, and hurried us to order.
The servers act like you are ruining their day when you ask for something.

themes.label: Cheap prices, good value
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise low prices and good value for noodle soups and other dishes, though one called a curry soup a rip-off.
quotes: Their noodle dishes are one of the best bang for your buck deals in NYC.
It's only 5 or 6 dollars.

themes.label: Duck dishes
themes.text: The duck, especially the country style duck, is frequently called a highlight, though one reviewer says it is not as good as it used to be.
quotes: The country style duck is to die for!
Love their variety of noodle soups, and the best soy sauce duck

themes.label: Noodle soups
themes.text: Noodle soups such as curry chicken, Cambodian, fish dumpling and pho are widely praised as tasty and satisfying.
quotes: If you want to have a bowl of soup that is a meal in itself, go to Bo-Ky.
Best curry noodles ever... Come here if you like good food.

themes.label: Cleanliness and smell
themes.text: Some reviewers complain about sanitation, smell, flies or food that felt unclean, while one found the restaurant clean after renovation.
quotes: This place is responsible for the worst smelling corner in all of NYC, and the food is a reflection of that
They just renovated so it's a lot cleaner and brighter than before.

themes.label: Fresh made-to-order rice rolls
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise rice rolls made fresh to order, describing them as tender, tasty and melt-in-the-mouth, with a choice of fillings.
quotes: Fresh, made to order chang fen that is so tender/melt in your mouth/amazing.
The freshly made rice rolls are delicious and consistent here.

themes.label: Cheap prices
themes.text: Many reviewers highlight very low prices, with most items around $1.50 to $2.50, and call it a great deal.
quotes: Great flavor and very filling for $2.50 with all the sauces. One of the best deals in Chinatown!
You also can't beat the price of $2 a serving.

themes.label: Sauces and toppings
themes.text: Reviewers like choosing toppings and adding generous sauces such as hot sauce, peanut sauce and soy sauce to their rice rolls.
quotes: You can pick your own toppings from a list they have at the order window.
unlimited sauces available; siracha, peanut and sweet soy sauce

themes.label: Lines and language barrier
themes.text: Reviewers mention lines and ordering difficulty for non-Chinese speakers, though some say the line moves quickly and is worth the wait.
quotes: There's usually a line on weekend mornings (it moves quickly!), it's cash only, and if you don't speak Chinese you might need a helper.
If you don't speak their native language, expect a lack of attention

themes.label: Soy milk and tofu
themes.text: Reviewers mention fresh soy milk and sweet tofu as good extras, though one reviewer reports finding a roach in their soy milk.
quotes: Best fresh soybean milk in town.
The tofu was truly fresh, they give you a small container of sugar syrup with it.

themes.label: Sandwich quality and variety
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the sandwiches as good, creative and fresh, naming the Spicy Rizzak, roast beef and warm turkey, though a few found them dry or bland.
quotes: The sandwiches have always been on point, fresh ingredients and quality bread.
The roast beef sandwich here is one of the best I've ever had.

themes.label: Friendly or rude staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, helpful staff and baristas, but a few reported rude service and being turned away near closing.
quotes: Very friendly staff, excellent coffee and good sandwiches.
the woman who took my order was Rude!

themes.label: Coffee and drinks
themes.text: Coffee is often called excellent, and homemade sodas and lemonade are liked, though one reviewer found the coffee and juice nothing special.
quotes: Coffee's excellent and the baristas are the sweetest.
The oj was nothing special and the iced coffee was nothing special.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere and seating
themes.text: Reviewers like the bright, cozy room with big windows and good music, with one mild complaint about hipster seating.
quotes: Well lit with large windows on 2 walls and great choice of background music.
calming music for that "relaxed at home" feeling.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable for the area and salads huge, while others call it overpriced with small portions.
quotes: Good sandwiches at a reasonable price for the area ($9-11).
The $10 Caesar salad was the size of my hand.

themes.label: Atmosphere and vibe
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the chill, friendly vibe and the look of the place, though a few find it small.
quotes: very chill and upscale spot, the vibe is great and the service is A1
Great music.. Great vibes.. Great people!

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, helpful staff, while others describe rude managers or bouncers and a waitress who neglected their order.
quotes: Great Staff that sets your mood right...
waitress came thru without a menu and asked us what we wanted as if we been there before or had menus

themes.label: Music selection
themes.text: Many like the music, but some complain of repeating playlists, no DJ, or a jumbled mix of songs.
quotes: Great music.. Great vibes.. Great people!
there weren't enough songs on this playlist to sit in there for over 2 hours

themes.label: Door lines and rules
themes.text: Several reviewers were frustrated by long waits outside, bouncers, time limits and the hookah-per-group policy, often while the place looked empty.
quotes: Took forever to get in so we left.
there is a 4:1 hookah policy and the 5 of us would have to get 2 hookahs

themes.label: Food and drinks
themes.text: Most find the food and drinks good, with chicken and waffles and brownie dessert singled out, but a few call the food bad or drinks weak.
quotes: Good drinks and awesome chicken and waffles!!
The food is bomb (one of the few places that serves food hot & not room temperature)!

themes.label: Tiny space, little seating
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly describe the shop as very small and cramped with few or no seats, though some mention benches or parks nearby.
quotes: Dessert Club is tiny inside, though, so it's almost impossible to find a seat!
Great desserts but it's so cramped inside that it's a hassle, especially in the winter.

themes.label: Churro cone and ice cream
themes.text: Most reviewers love the churro cones with soft serve and toppings, especially the s'mores and Nutty Professor, though a few found the cone disappointing.
quotes: the churro cone was spot on, and the marshmallow on top was even toasted!
The big attraction, the churro cone, was less than impressive.

themes.label: Delicious varied desserts
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the flavor and variety of desserts such as tiramisu mochi, cupcakes, crepe cake, doughsants and lava cake.
quotes: The tiramisu mochi and mango lava molten chocolate cake are amazing!
I tried 6 different flavored cupcakes and they were all great.

themes.label: Price
themes.text: A few reviewers found the prices high for what they got.
quotes: 10 dollars for a simple ice cream, but looks a bit fancy
Good ice cream served on churros.good tart but a bit expensive

themes.label: Crust, sauce and cheese quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the crispy, well-balanced crust, the sauce and the cheese, calling the slices among the best in New York.
quotes: The crust is to die for, crispy and complex in flavor.
Crust perfect. Cheese perfect. Sauce.....perfect.

themes.label: Loud music and atmosphere
themes.text: Many like the cool, throwback vibe and music, but others find the music too loud for conversation or for kids, and the room dark or cramped.
quotes: Superb slices in a cool throwback atmosphere with a NYC attirude
Music was loud and not a place for conversation.

themes.label: High slice prices
themes.text: Several reviewers say slices are expensive for what they get, though a few feel the quality still justifies the cost.
quotes: Great, pizza but honestly over priced for the quality and the wait. I've had better for less.
A bit on the expensive side per slice, but worth it.

themes.label: Friendly staff and bar
themes.text: Reviewers often mention friendly staff and bartenders and the back bar with beer, though one found a bartender unengaging.
quotes: We sat at the bar and the bartender was super friendly and funny.
Pizza is great, bar in back is a low key gem.

themes.label: Long waits and crowding
themes.text: Some reviewers describe long waits for pies or slices, a packed small room, and being short-staffed.
quotes: Was told a whole pie would take an hour.
they only had a couple slices out, and said it would be a two hour wait if I wanted to order a pie

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the Senegalese and West African food as delicious and authentic, naming dishes such as dibi, lamb, fish and rice.
quotes: Best dibi in the city! Beautiful and pleasant servers make it worth every minute and every bite!
Wonderful lamb stew in peanut sauce. Rich flavor and so much food, we had to bring food home.

themes.label: Customer service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, welcoming staff, but others report slow, inattentive or disrespectful service and uneven treatment.
quotes: Excellent service. They Deserve 10 stars
Nice food but they need to work on their costumer service

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers say portions are huge, with leftovers to take home, and some link this to reasonable prices.
quotes: You will have leftovers to take home with you every time!
Portions are huge. Make sure to get a side of plantains

themes.label: Delivery speed and conduct
themes.text: Several customers complain of very long delivery waits, around two hours, and one reports a rude delivery driver.
quotes: the worst customer service , slowest delivery :(
How come a delivery always takes me more than 2 hours

themes.label: Cleanliness of the restaurant
themes.text: Reviewers describe the restaurant as clean and comfortable.
quotes: Good food and clean. I can recommend this to anyone
The restaurant is clean and comfortable.

themes.label: Ramen and broth quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise flavorful broth, tender pork and unusual ramens, but some find the broth weak, bitter or flavorless, especially in later reviews.
quotes: Perfect ramen, flavorful broth and melt in your mouth chashu.
Lemon black pepper tonkatsu soup has no lemon or black pepper flavor at all.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Staff are repeatedly described as friendly, attentive and lovely, though a few early reviews wanted faster service and one found it sloppy.
quotes: The staff are always lovely, and the setting (as well as particular utensil choices) are great to be around and use.
The place would work better with faster service.

themes.label: Green curry and signature ramens
themes.text: Green curry, lemon and black pepper, and truffle oil ramens are singled out as popular and enjoyable, though lemon ramen disappointed a few.
quotes: In particular, the green curry ramen is amazing.
was actually quite delicious and the pork was probably the best pork I ever had that came with my ramen

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some call prices affordable or fair, while others find the ramen pricey for small portions or the quality.
quotes: The prices are very fair and include tip.
I didn't think it was worth what they were charging

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: Many like the cozy, chill vibe and details like ceramics, but the basement spot is small, hard to find and called dated or unclean by some.
quotes: poetic details such as beautiful ceramics, wooden cutlery and origami decorating the table

themes.label: Rice balls (onigiri)
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the fresh onigiri and rice balls, especially shrimp tempura and spicy mayo, though one found the crab filling skimpy and the takoyaki chewy.
quotes: the onigiri is phenomenal, especially the shrimp tempura with the spicy mayo.
the rice balls are fresh beyond belief!

themes.label: Bubble tea and drinks
themes.text: Most praise the fresh, varied, customizable teas and fruit teas, but some say drinks taste watered down, weak or too sweet.
quotes: Yaya's fruit teas have a very unique flavor that I haven't tasted anywhere else.
Taste like water. Flavor is not noticeable at all.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many call prices good or cheap for boba, especially large sizes, while others find it a bit pricey.
quotes: It's actually cheaper than most bubble tea stores in Manhattan.
It's a little expensive in my opinion but overall pretty decent

themes.label: Seating and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers mention limited seating and crowds, with lines and packed conditions, though one found plenty of space at their location.
quotes: there are times when they get a large line and no seats are available.
Not much seating in the dining area

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Staff are often described as friendly and helpful, though one reviewer found service slow and another complained about delivery drivers.
quotes: The staff guided us through what to get and how to order.
Service is slow because everything is a la minute but food is tasty.

themes.label: Tasty Jamaican dishes
themes.text: Many reviewers praise the flavor of dishes like oxtail, curry goat, jerk chicken and rice and peas, though a few found some dishes dry, tough or inauthentic.
quotes: Curry goat falls off the bone, delicious!!!!
Ox tail was authentic, taste was suberb and the rice and peas taste like home

themes.label: Staff attitude and service
themes.text: Some find staff friendly and quick, while many describe attitude, rudeness, slow service or trouble with special requests and orders.
quotes: Attitudinal Staff and always seem to serve way to much Rice & Peas & not ever enough Meat & Vegetables.
Open 24 hours and the food is excellent. The staff is always friendly.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Most reviewers call prices low and portions large, but some say it is pricey, that portions favor rice, or that costs are higher via delivery.
quotes: Huge portions for a very low price.
Prices should reflect portions sold ($5, 7, 9.00) respectively.

themes.label: Long lines and waits
themes.text: Reviewers often mention lines, slow service and a wait for food, though some say the food is worth it.
quotes: can be a little slow because it can get crowed, but food is always worth the wait
don't go there if you are in a rush, it's usually a line & they are very slow.

themes.label: Small takeout space
themes.text: Reviewers note the restaurant is tiny and takeout only, with several wishing for a bigger place.
quotes: My only complaint is that they need a bigger place.

themes.label: Pastrami and sandwich quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pastrami, corned beef and Reuben as tender, flavorful and the best they've had, though a few find them overhyped.
quotes: Best pastrami in the world. A must everytime I'm in New York!

Not exactly cheap, but absolutely worth a visit!

themes.label: Service and staff

Very good service and good recommendations from the waiter, to repeat

Best view of the city especially at sun down

quotes: Great place for a concert. Must go to
Here for Ringo Starr anf his All Star Band, a great concert venue.
